# AppSpec DIY Manual

Practical command cookbook for running and maintaining AppSpec locally.

Repository root used below:

`AppSpec/`

## 1) Local Paths And Defaults

- Backend working directory: `backend/`
- Default database file: `database/appspec.db`
- Default backend URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8010`
- `TPL_ENV` for local work: `DEV`

Why this matters:
- All commands below assume you run from AppSpec root first, then switch into `backend/`.
- The DB URL is intentionally pinned so AppSpec writes to its own DB, not another app's DB.

## 2) Preflight (Run First)

What this does:
- Validates that your current Python interpreter can import the AppSpec backend package.
- Prevents running long commands with the wrong interpreter/environment.

```{bash}
cd backend && python -c "import app.main; print('app import OK')"
```

If this fails, you are using the wrong Python interpreter for AppSpec.

## 3) Database Setup / Reset (Mandatory Before API Use)

What this does:
- Creates AppSpec tables from current SQLAlchemy model metadata.
- Uses only in-repo modules that currently exist in AppSpec.
- No seed step is available in AppSpec at the moment.

```{bash}
cd backend && \
export TPL_ENV=DEV && \
export TPL_DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///../database/appspec.db" && \
python - <<'PY'
from app.database import Base, engine
import app.models  # registers model metadata
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
print("AppSpec schema created/verified")
PY
```

Alternative (if your terminal is already in `backend/`):

```{bash}
export TPL_ENV=DEV
export TPL_DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///../database/appspec.db"
python - <<'PY'
from app.database import Base, engine
import app.models
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
print("AppSpec schema created/verified")
PY
```

## 4) Start Backend

What this does:
- Starts AppSpec API server on port `8010`.
- `--reload` auto-restarts server when backend files change.
- If `8010` is already occupied, first stop the listener process.

Kill existing process on `8010` (optional but recommended before restart):

```{bash}
pid=$(lsof -tiTCP:8010 -sTCP:LISTEN)
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
  kill "$pid"
fi
```

```{bash}
cd backend && \
export TPL_ENV=DEV && \
export TPL_DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///../database/appspec.db" && \
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8010
```

Health check:

What this confirms:
- Server process is reachable on `8010`.
- Basic API startup works before testing feature endpoints.

```{bash}
curl http://127.0.0.1:8010/api/health
```

## 5) Verify GUI-Spec Endpoint

What this confirms:
- Route registration is correct (`/api/gui-specs/views` exists).
- Backend can process request up to auth/role checks.

```{bash}
curl -i \
  -H "X-AppSpec-User-Id: 7" \
  -H "X-AppSpec-Roles: DEV,SPECIFICATION_USER" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8010/api/gui-specs/views?include_done=false
```

Expected:
- `403` if developer role is missing
- not `404`
- not `500`

## 6) Use From TPLK Frontend (Glue Mode)

What this does:
- Points TPLK frontend to AppSpec backend for GUI-spec calls.
- Lets you open overlay UI in TPLK while AppSpec remains backend owner.

```{bash}
cd ../TPLK-App/frontend
export VITE_APPSPEC_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8010
npm run dev
```

## 7) Troubleshooting

### `Could not reach the server`
- AppSpec backend not running on `8010`
- or frontend not restarted after exporting `VITE_APPSPEC_API_BASE_URL`

### `sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table: USER`
- Legacy hint from old scaffold.
- AppSpec no longer owns local `USER` tables.
- If you see any `no such table` error, run Section 3 and restart backend.

### `sqlite3.OperationalError: unable to open database file`
- Wrong DB URL/path; use:
  - `sqlite:///../database/appspec.db` (when run from `backend/`)

### `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'app'`
- Start commands from wrong directory.
- Use the chained form in this manual (`cd backend && ...`) to enforce correct module path.

### Commands accidentally concatenated into one line
- Run commands line-by-line (`cd`, `export`, `python ...`, `uvicorn ...`).
